items.title: Musica
relevant_lines: Scopri come candidarti gratuitamente per lavorare come cantante, musicista e altre figure artistiche legate al mondo della musica!
Audizioni Opera e Lirica a Roma: cercasi cantanti lirici e professori d’orchestra — soprani, mezzosoprani, tenori, baritoni, bassi.
Selezioni aperte per artisti del settore musicale e lirico.
items.auto_review_reason: The stable Musica category explicitly covers singers and music professionals and currently lists an opera-singer audition with named voice types. The publisher self-identifies as a general casting portal that accepts externally submitted notices and warns that not all third-party notices are fully reliable; therefore it is approved only as a high-value third-party discovery source, never as an official publisher.
items.review_notes: Discovery-only. Third-party listings report an application deadline of 2026-11-13 and an audition on 2026-11-17 in Rome. Rechecked 2026-11-12: the official Opera e Lirica Job Position page lists a separate Social Media Content Creator vacancy, not this singer audition; Turismo Roma confirms the organizer identity and official website but not the audition. Do not add this notice to data/opportunities.json without direct organizer confirmation.

lead_crosscheck.evidence_excerpt: The official Opera e Lirica site currently lists a Social Media Content Creator vacancy and uses candidatureopera@gmail.com. Turismo Roma identifies Opera e Lirica and its official website.
lead_crosscheck.finding: The organizer identity and email use are corroborated, but the official site does not publish the specific 17 November 2026 singer audition. Multiple third-party listings repeat the notice; retain only as a third-party lead.

auto_review_evidence.excerpt: The official website's current Job Position page lists a Social Media Content Creator vacancy and uses candidatureopera@gmail.com; it does not publish the 17 November singer audition.
The official Rome tourism listing identifies Opera e Lirica, its website www.opera-lirica.com, and its public contact details.

items.title: Teatro Lirico Sperimentale di Spoleto — official homepage
relevant_lines: Official homepage identifies Istituzione Teatro Lirico Sperimentale di Spoleto A. Belli.
Search-indexed official homepage announces the 81st International Singing Competition for 16–20 February 2027.
The official indexed page says the competition call and further information will be available soon.
items.auto_review_reason: The official Bandi e avvisi page directly links to this dedicated page; the page identifies the 81st International Singing Competition for young opera singers, gives the dates 16–20 February 2027, and its footer identifies Istituzione Teatro Lirico Sperimentale di Spoleto A. Belli. Publisher identity and vocal relevance are high-confidence. The parent page was successfully fetched by the existing production source refresh on 2026-11-11; robots.txt for this exact child path was not independently retrievable in this audit.
items.review_notes: Source candidate only; do not promote or publish an opportunity from this record. On 2026-11-23 the official root hostname passes standard TLS certificate and hostname verification, but the homepage is password-protected and the former child paths return 404. The official site's indexed content announces the 81st competition for 16–20 February 2027 and says the call is forthcoming. Recheck the official site after its reported 26 November 2026 relaunch. No deadline, eligibility, fee or application route is currently verified.

auto_review_evidence.page_title: Bandi e avvisi - Teatro Lirico Sperimentale di Spoleto
auto_review_evidence.excerpt: The institution's official notices page directly links to the dedicated 81st International Singing Competition page.
The official competition page still announces 16–20 February 2027 and says the bando and further information will be available soon; no deadline, eligibility, fee or application form is published.

items.access_policy_note: A strict HTTPS request to the homepage returns HTTP 200 but redirects to a password-protected login page. The former Bandi e Avvisi and competition child paths return 404. DUE MONDI NEWS reported that the institution planned to present its new website and the 81st competition on 26 November 2026; this is third-party context, not official competition terms.
